rationale: The mass reads as one compact bent plate with a small upper shift, so it is coherent in plan and silhouette, but the visible four-view result still behaves like a generic sealed bar rather than a neighborhood-living building with an active ground edge and a real public void. The blue frontage edge is acknowledged only weakly; there is no clear undercut, court, or entry seam directed to the access side. The form is not broken across views and does not visibly collide, so repair integrity is acceptable, but the program contract is not satisfied because the dominant gesture does not produce a legible public threshold or meaningful shared open space. Reference language supports courtyard/terrace/interlocking massing and a folded or terraced section, none of which is yet convincingly present.
